data.body: Additional maintained-project comparison: softrams/bulwark (~187 stars, updated 2026-06) uses a simpler one-way ownership model. Each vulnerability stores its Jira ID/URL; the integration explicitly creates or updates that known Jira issue and explicitly adds the parent issue link. It does not infer link deletion from absence. Source: https://github.com/softrams/bulwark/blob/master/src/utilities/jira.utility.ts. This avoids the ambiguity entirely but cannot satisfy rebar's bidirectional-deletion requirement. Together with GitHub's stateful GHAS sync, the common pattern is: retain durable association/provenance and perform explicit managed mutations; do not treat an unqualified missing link as deletion.
